brief: A mobile-first meal-planning app for busy households of 2–5 people. Plan five weeknight dinners from dietary preferences and pantry ingredients, create consolidated shopping lists, let adult household members suggest and vote on meals, track pantry freshness, and set optional weekly grocery budgets. No bank accounts, payments, transfers, transaction history, bill pay, or financial dashboards. Lists must work offline in a grocery store and sync across adults. Recipes need editable portions, clear allergen labels, and large-text controls; adults manage household membership.
